description: T-2957: D2 (just right of table T, A1:C4) typed =A2*2: does T auto-expand (COLUMNS/ROWS of T[#All] in H1:H2, header D1 in H3:H4) and is the new column filled (FORMULATEXT in F1:F4). D1 is the header text Excel writes (not a formula, so the sidecar does not record it): `Column1`, as the oracle's H3 (`=D1&""`) and H4 (`ISFORMULA(D1)` FALSE) read it (T-2968).
